tests.title: Print RFID tags for a newly registered item
tests.goal:
Asset Tag Printing

Verify that a registered item can be sent to tag printing and then shows a tag printed time.
preconditions: A registered item without a printed tag
A printer configured in Asset Tag Printing

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Pick the printer and label size, select the new item under Print new tags

expected.text: Item Register > Registered items not checked in yet shows a Tag printed time for the item
Check In / Out > Printed lists the item with Tag Printed On
The item has a 24-digit chip code (encoded RFID) and can no longer be deleted

notes: Printer "test", label size By category, 3 QA items: "3 tag(s) sent to the printer: 001000031, 002000017, 003000025."; each got a 24-digit chip code (e.g. 010020000000000001000031), Tag printed 18/11/2026 12:18 in Item Register (Edit only, no Delete), listed under Printed; Audit "Tag code issued ... First print" + "Tag printed".

tests.title: Label size By category picks the tag type of the item's category
tests.goal:
Tag type by category

Verify that printing with label size By category uses Anti-Liquid for chemicals, Metal for assets and Paper (box tag) for other categories.
preconditions: Registered unprinted items of category Chemical, Asset and Consumable

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Asset Tag Printing, pick the printer and label size By category
Select one Chemical, one Asset and one Consumable item and print

expected.text: The Label details column (or printed labels) show Anti-Liquid 46 x 40 mm for the chemical, Metal 50 x 15 mm for the asset and Paper 73 x 20 mm for the consumable
Each item gets a 24-digit chip code

notes: Printed By category on printer "test", but the tag type used is not shown in the web (Label details, Printed list) or the Audit Trail, so Anti-Liquid / Metal / Paper cannot be checked without the printer output. Chip codes: asset 01002..., chemical and consumable 01001... (meaning not documented).

tests.title: Reprinting a tag issues a new chip code and retires the old tag
tests.goal:
Reprint

Verify that reprinting an item's tag gives it a new 24-digit chip code and that the old code is no longer recognised.
preconditions: An item with a printed tag

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account and note the item's chip code (Item Information details or tag history)
Open Registration > Asset Tag Printing > Reprint tags, select the item and reprint
Look the item up by the old and the new chip code

expected.text: The item has a new chip code different from the old one
A gantry read or lookup with the old code no longer finds the item; the new one does

notes: Reprint 001000031 on printer "test": "1 tag(s) sent to the printer: 001000031. The old tags of these items no longer work."; chip code 010020000000000001000031 -> 010030000000000001000031; GET /api/Item/byencodedrfid old -> 404, new -> 001000031; encodedtaghistory: First print (deleted) + Reprint.
